trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side content, activities, collectibles, and finally cleanup. The platinum is the last trophy you earn, so treat it as the finish line, not a job of its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you play — just finish the mission and the trophy pops. It only counts when the mission completes, so do not quit out partway through.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing the story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The official description names only the chapter, so confirm in game which mission closes it — play every story mission as it appears and you cannot miss it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing the story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The official description names only the chapter, so confirm in game which mission closes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing the story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The official description names only the chapter, so confirm in game which mission closes it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing the story missions in order. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The official description names only the chapter, so confirm in game which mission closes it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Finish every chapter first — the final mission unlocks at the end of Chapter 4. Save before the finale if you want to replay the ending, and confirm in game whether the ending branches, since the official description gives no mission name.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story in order and the mission appears when it is due; finish it and the trophy pops. The official description gives no chapter for it, so confirm in game where it falls in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long grind: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed the completion percentage. Check the in-game stats page to see what is left, finish everything else first, and this pops last or near-last. It is not missable — it only needs patience.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime while driving — chain them in free roam and the count climbs. A fast car and the open highways around Vice City help; the running total is tracked in the stats menu, so check it as you go.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types — sample one of each, such as a race, the shooting range, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, meditation, a drone race and stunts. Confirm in game which nine the activities menu lists, and tick them off one by one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 challenges in total. Work through each weapon class; gold needs speed and accuracy, so learn the target patterns and retry until the gold threshold clears. Confirm in game where the range is, since the official description gives no location.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total. A win counts per location, not per race, so move on once a location is ticked. Learn each course's line first, then race it for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races across Leonida — street, off-road and water races all count as long as each race is a different one. Twenty distinct wins are needed, so vary the events rather than repeating a single favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the official description gives no spot, so confirm in game where Cal fishes. Buy the best rod you can afford first; better gear makes the challenge much easier.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start any game and play it through to its end. Confirm in game which arcade holds the cabinets — the official description gives no place, so ask around the map markers for an arcade.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand to its end — the final mission unlocks only after his earlier missions. It is a single mission, so finish it when it appears. Confirm in game where Andy's strand begins, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand to its end — the final mission unlocks only after his earlier missions. It is a single mission, so finish it when it appears. Confirm in game where Kenton's strand begins, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand to its end — the final mission unlocks only after his earlier missions. It is a single mission, so finish it when it appears. Confirm in game where Billy's strand begins, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — take each strand to its end. Eight completed strands are needed, and the count is tracked in the stats menu, so work through them as you explore the state.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand to its end — the final mission unlocks only after his earlier missions. It is a single mission, so finish it when it appears. Confirm in game where Randy's strand begins, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand to its end — the final mission unlocks only after his earlier missions. It is a single mission, so finish it when it appears. Confirm in game where Tyrone's strand begins, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in total. Visit each one and meditate there. The spots are scattered across the state, so check them off as you explore and confirm in game where each spot sits.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand leads to the hunt — follow his missions until it opens. The official description gives no species and no place, so confirm in game what animal it is and where it roams.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set completes when every card in it is found. Three full sets are needed — keep a checklist as you go, and confirm in game how many cards each set holds.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing activity — use it at 100 different spots. The count is tracked in the stats menu, so spread it across the map as you explore rather than doing it all in one place.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — races, stunts, combat and more. Fifty completed challenges are needed; the counter is in the stats menu, so dip into the challenge list often and clear the easy ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside or the water to lose the cops — and do it with your partner present, or it will not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, keep the wanted level, and hit two more in a row with your partner beside you. Plan a route with three close shops and a fast getaway car waiting.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — the game logs each new one. Variety matters: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count toward the 100, so try everything you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and drop five before it ends. A crowded firefight with weak enemies is the easiest setup — let them group up first.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. Leave in a way the schedule never planned: take a plane and get airborne. The official description gives no exact trigger, so confirm in game what counts as the departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — Rhinos are tanks. The trophy involves the Rhino tank, most likely a military-base or high-wanted-level encounter with one. Confirm in game what exactly triggers it, since the official description is a joke and gives no task.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you. Plan the entry, move slowly, take what you came for and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A failed stealth run can be retried.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. Space them out, plan a getaway route for each one, and do not rush — a busted run does not count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and get away clean. Trucks run set routes around the state — confirm in game where they spawn, then pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the state. Drive, fly or sail through each named area until the map fills in. The count is tracked in the stats menu, so check which areas are left and sweep through them on a road trip.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. Hit one illegal operation per gang, nine robberies in all, one for each gang's territory. Confirm in game which operation belongs to which gang before you strike.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The official description gives no bar name, so confirm in game which spot on the beach serves it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's front in a car, the classic way out. Confirm in game which showroom triggers it, since the official description names none.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley and follow through on your throw. Confirm in game where the alley sits, since the official description gives no place.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it involves your partner and something the public notices. Confirm in game what triggers it, since the official description gives no task.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Story choices add up — the trophy list tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Keep making choices as you play the story and it pops when the count is met. Confirm in game which choices count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try. The official description gives no event, so confirm in game which retry it tracks — it is most likely tied to a specific mission or activity attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens somewhere in Leonida — an odd event or encounter. The official description gives no place, so confirm in game what the strange event is and where to find it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep the speed low enough to land the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It accumulates over the whole game, so keep laundering as bills come in — it is a slow earner, not a one-time job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and more all count toward the total. It accumulates as you play, so it comes naturally if you shop as you go — check the stats menu to see how far along you are.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Save up and buy them as they appear on the market; each purchase is tracked. Garages are also useful for storing the vehicles other trophies need.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own in the app — buy or find ten and register each one. It pairs well with the vehicle-discovery trophy, so do them together.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 in order and finish the final mission. This phase earns the chapter trophies and the named story missions — 12 trophies, 11 of them single-mission and missable only in the sense that each mission must be finished when it appears. Do the story first: later phases build on the map and gear it unlocks.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side missions
roadmap.text: Clear the stranger strands and the contact finales — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's hunt and 8 stranger strands in total. Five of these are single-mission finales, so finish each strand when its missions appear. This phase earns 7 trophies.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.text: Work the activities: 250 stunts, all 42 Shooting Range challenges for gold, drone races at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, fishing against Cal, an arcade game, meditation at all 18 spots, 50 challenges, and a frame at the bowling alley. Ten trophies, all repeatable — grind them between story beats or after the story ends.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: Sweep the map: 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida explored, all 8 garage properties bought, and 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Six trophies — best done with a checklist and a long drive.

roadmap.title: Cleanup: combat, money, 100%
roadmap.text: Finish the combat and money trophies — wanted-level escapes, shop and bank robberies, Combat Focus, the armored truck, one illegal operation per gang — plus the odd secret moments, $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent. Then 100% completion, and the platinum lands last. Twenty trophies in this phase.
